lines.trans: Tamara, hello, this is Vitya Barinov calling.
Hi, Vitya, do you want to place a bet?
Yes, put money on the Spartak match.
Are you betting on your native Spartak's victory?
No, I am betting on a CSKA victory!
Are you not joking? They are your enemies!
I bet exactly one hundred thousand rubles!
Do you have that kind of money with you?
Reserve the bet, I will bring cash soon.
All right, your bet is accepted at the office.
Thank you, money right now matters more than anything to me.
I hope you understand your huge risk.

беспокоить.gloss: to bother, to disturb; to worry

examples.trans: I don't want to bother you.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: end-stressed in oblique forms: врага, врагу
plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it
to one person you call ты; здравствуйте is the polite form; the first в is silent

examples.trans: The bet was accepted at the office.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?
Put your foot on the bed.

meanings.note: from a trip, by car, train or plane

принять.gloss: to receive, to see (a visitor); to accept

examples.trans: You are afraid of any risk.

meanings.note: ровно десять секунд = exactly ten seconds

meanings.en: dear, darling, my friend (in address: родной мой)

meanings.note: родной брат = full brother; родной город = hometown

examples.text: Ну что, родной мой, за тебя!
examples.trans: Well then, my dear friend, to you!
I haven't got a single rouble.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word
спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

meanings.en: to put, to place in an upright position

examples.trans: Where should I put the plate?
Put the kettle on the table.

meanings.note: сто пятьдесят = a hundred and fifty; сто рублей = a hundred roubles

examples.trans: I've got a hundred and ten.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: the noun after it is genitive plural: тысячи мест

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
